construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)
candidate_note: LOCKED corpus ×50 (k2 cell 2026-08-19; chips and ledger 2026-09-04); k2_card registers remain an unauthored stub.

candidates.structural_interaction: Earth generating Metal cross-polarity — stability nourishing precision and opening direction
candidates.k2_overview: Your Earth moves as the Sage: mother ground, nurture in its home element, doubled. You hold people the way land holds houses, unconditionally, for generations, without once mentioning the load. Wisdom settles in you and stays. The whole village builds on your patience. Somewhere in the acreage, keep a field that feeds only you.
candidates.k2_functional: You think in generational wisdom: what held the family, what will hold it next.

k2_domain_readings.Knowledge: Your knowledge is settled sediment: practical wisdom layered by years, the kind villages consult. You know what actually works. Write the almanac down. Ground should not be the only copy.
k2_domain_readings.Shelter: Your shelter is the family land itself: people return to you between every attempt at the world. Being home is holy work with no clock. Post seasons. Even land lies fallow.
k2_domain_readings.Nurture: The nourishing thread is bedrock here. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. Where it was missing, you became the ground yourself. Keep one plot for you.

angles.drive: Your presence calms people before your words do. Since you need people safe rather than impressed, you calm them with the slow question ahead of the fix. Let someone be the calm one for you sometimes, because you need calming as much as anyone.
angles.cost_self: Being the calm one comes naturally, and you forget it weighs anything. You calm someone through a bad month rather than admit your own, so you put yourself last. Say the tired thing out loud, since you pay for everyone's calm in rest not taken.
angles.cost_others: Whenever you watch someone close to you come apart, you become the calm under them. You calm them rather than get calmed, and hide every shake of your own. Let them see you wobble, because you give them no chance to calm you back.

angles.drive: Knowing what works comes easier to you than hoping something unproven will. Because you need an answer to have lasted, you reach for what has worked over what sounds clever. Give a new idea one honest try, since every answer you trust was new once.
angles.cost_self: Faced with a new way, you wait for proof rather than try it. Knowing what works means more to you than being early, so you land safe and late. Try one untested thing, because you miss the chances that wanted you early.
angles.cost_others: The advice you give has already worked somewhere. Knowing what works better than what someone hopes for, you send their new idea home with an old one. Hear the new idea out, since you take from them the chance to be wrong their own way.

angles.drive: You teach a thing a third time with the patience of the first. Needing the person to get there, you teach at their pace ahead of your own. Keep one hour a week that teaches nobody, because only you fill your patience back up.
angles.cost_self: Teaching someone patiently is easy for you and hard to count. Since you wait for them rather than hurry them, you hand your own evening to the teaching. Say no to one lesson a week, because you take every patient lesson out of your rest.
angles.cost_others: Your patience is what you teach with first. You teach it a second time instead of watching someone struggle, and take the struggle that made it theirs. Let them not know a while longer, since you take the practice with every answer handed over.

angles.drive: Playing it safe is a choice you make before looking at the others. You carry Earth past what you need, so you play safe to be held instead of tested. You rest in the safe place rather than live in it.
angles.cost_self: Most days you play safe without noticing you chose. Because you fear the unknown more than you mind being bored, you pick the safe one and call the boredom peace. You buy that peace with the chances you turn down untried.
angles.cost_others: Handed someone's plan to change the shared life, you play safe for both. Keeping things as they are matters more than any change, and you slow it down. You take away their equal say in the life you share.

angles.drive: Protecting the people you love is the first thing you do with news. Because you treat their safety as your job, you protect them from a risk rather than watch them take it. You get to let them take their own risks.
angles.cost_self: When trouble lands on someone you love, you protect them as your own. You carry their trouble rather than let them carry it, and pick up weight nobody handed you. You look after everyone and leave no one looking after you.
angles.cost_others: Your protection arrives before anyone asks. Because you find watching someone struggle harder than doing it for them, you protect them by taking over instead of letting them finish badly. With every rescue, you take a lesson away from them.

angles.drive: The same old answers are the ones you reach for first. Because you trust a handed-down answer over a new one, you ask the same few voices rather than a stranger. You keep the answer long after the question has moved on.
angles.cost_self: Reaching for the same old answer beats finding a fresh one. You trust what you were told over what you tested, so you stop asking early. You inherited those answers rather than earned them, and you own only what you earn.
angles.cost_others: Your first answer to someone's new idea is the same old one. Because you find a tested answer kinder, you give the old one rather than the one asked for. You send them off with your answer in place of theirs.

retired_2026-09-20_batch3.k2_domain_readings.Mother: The mother-thread is bedrock here: nurture received deep or a hollow you filled by becoming the ground yourself. Either origin made you everyone’s home. Claim one plot back.

retired_2026-09-20_nurture.k2_domain_readings.Nurture: The nurturing thread is bedrock here: nurture received deep or a hollow you filled by becoming the ground yourself. Either origin made you everyone’s home. Claim one plot back.

edge.lead: Earth runs through your family, your mind and your health. It is the calm the whole house borrows on a bad night, the answer you trust because it has worked before, and the quiet hour that puts you back together.
